newsitem.title: USA: Toolex-Alpha sees 1996 revs, EPS lower.
newsitem.headline: Toolex-Alpha sees 1996 revs, EPS lower.

text.p: Toolex-Alpha NV said Thursday it expects to report less-than-expected revenues and earnings per share for the 1996 fiscal year.
The company said it anticipates reporting 1996 revenues of 577.7 million Swedish crowns, and earnings per share for the year of 4.1 Swedish crowns.

In the prior year, the company posted revenues of 603.7 million Swedish crowns. Per share figures for the prior year were not available because the company completed its initial public offering in May 1996.
Toolex-Alpha, a Stockholm-based developer and manufacturer of systems for the production of optical discs, said it intends to issue the results of the 1996 year on February 25.
Toolex-Alpha President Goran Barsby said in a statement that the lower revenues and earnings were due largely to deferred orders, as well as higher sales and marketing expenses.
